preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 10 and 40 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c in '-+() ' for c in S) or '@' in S
preconditions.description: The input string S contains only alphanumeric characters, spaces, or dashes, or it contains the '@' symbol for an email address.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is the same as the input string.

postconditions.expression: result.islower() if '@' in S else all(c.isdigit() or c in '-+() ' for c in result)
postconditions.description: If the input is an email address, the output is in lowercase and all characters except the first and last letter of the first name are replaced with asterisks. If the input is a phone number, the output is masked according to the specified format.
